mapper.select: SELECT uc.coupon_id id, c.coupon_name couponName, c.coupon_type couponType, c.min_order_amount minOrderAmount, c.coupon_desc couponDesc, c.coupon_money couponMoney, c.is_global isGlobal, c.coupon_discount couponDiscount, c.shop_id shopId, uc.end_date endDate, uc.coupon_id couponId, uc.id userCouponId FROM user_coupon uc LEFT JOIN coupon c ON uc.coupon_id = c.coupon_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{currentUserId} AND c.shop_id = #{shopId} AND uc.start_date <= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW()) AND uc.end_date >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW()) AND uc.order_id = 0 AND c.is_delete = 0 AND uc.used_time = 0;
SELECT uc.coupon_id FROM user_coupon uc INNER JOIN coupon c ON c.coupon_id = uc.coupon_id WHERE c.send_num > 0 GROUP BY uc.coupon_id, c.send_num HAVING COUNT(uc.id) >= c.send_num
